name: Italian Sausage-Cabbage Stew with Tomato, Carrot, Parmesan & Toast

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, ground sausage, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground pork sausage
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
When the sausage is done, add veggies, broth, and tomatoes to the pot. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the pot and stir to combine (set remaining parsley aside for serving).
Once the stew is simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are soft, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the stew is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.

Arrange bread slices on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut toasts in half.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices whole grain bread
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Divide stew between bowls; sprinkle with Parmesan and reserved parsley. Serve with toast on the side and enjoy!
